content: Nagaemo Poloꞌnamo Goti apa vekaꞌamo maiꞌneꞌnaeꞌmo avoꞌmo nekaove. Ma mopafi vayaꞌmogi apa aliꞌyateꞌmo lekana paiꞌa oꞌnateꞌnageno Gotiꞌa mago vayaꞌaitetiꞌmo navaleno oꞌnateꞌniye. Yesu Kalaisiꞌe Afotimoꞌmo Yesu Kalaisiꞌa faliꞌniyatetiꞌmo alino he tino ateꞌniya Gotiꞌeꞌmo lekana paiꞌana nateteꞌana apa aliꞌyateꞌmo navaleꞌana nateꞌnaꞌae.
Nagaeꞌe muki nagaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeꞌa maiꞌnaya konagatapimogiꞌeꞌmo Galesiya kotega alita anupa hutapa maiꞌnaya siosiꞌale siosiꞌalefeꞌmo ge nelapamamaone.
Gotiꞌa Afotimoꞌe Ala kava netimo Yesu Kalaisiꞌeꞌmo fiku lapa maeꞌana lapamiꞌanageno lapaipamoꞌmo falu hino.
Gotiꞌa Afotimoꞌmo hauꞌnigeno Kalaisi geꞌamo akame huno hemenimo ma mopafi haneꞌniya hosu kavategatiꞌmo lagufamo alino katino latesiyafeꞌmo hosu kavatilefeꞌmo agufamo amiteno faliꞌniye.
Goti agiꞌaleꞌmo muki afinaꞌae afinaꞌaeꞌmo alita asaga huge huge huta maigetao.
Alagepa faigoko gemo magokeꞌagekeꞌmo haneꞌniya gemae
Aise afinaꞌmo utegetapaeꞌmo Gotiꞌa lapakaefeꞌmo keya aeno ge huteno Kalaisitetiꞌmo fiku lapa maeno lapamiꞌniya vekamo ataletapa alu faigoko gemo afisayafeꞌmo neꞌvageꞌna nahau aiꞌnove.
Alu alagepa faigoko gemo ohaneꞌniyaꞌmonanafa mago vayaꞌmogimo alagepa faigoko gemo aliꞌa aiꞌa ataginovano gemo huteꞌa lapakesamo nefaigetapaeꞌmo lapausoli nehae.

Lagaemofi kokuꞌnapatiꞌmo eminesiya enisole vekamoꞌmofi huta alagepa faigoko gemo lapa paiꞌnona gemo ataleta alu faigoko gemo aeta hakalo huta lapa paisunana Gotiꞌa alino laha faitalenageta alagi lageso hino.

Hogoteta ani gemo ago huꞌnonanageꞌna hemenimo halate magoꞌe huꞌna ani agufa gegeꞌmo huꞌnaeꞌmo, mago vayaꞌmogi ago lapa paiꞌnonagetapa afitetapa aliꞌnaya gemo osuꞌa alu faigoko gemo lapa paiꞌnisayaꞌmoꞌmo Gotiꞌa alino hapa faitalenageꞌa alagi lageso hiyo, huꞌna nehuve.

Nagaemo vayaꞌmogi amuse huꞌa natesayafeꞌmo nahaꞌye nehigeꞌna kahauya nehufiye. Haꞌao, Gotikeꞌmo amuse huno natesiyafeꞌmo nahaꞌye nehigeꞌna kahauya nehuve. Hogoteꞌna vayaꞌaifeꞌmo nagesamo afiꞌnovaꞌmonanafa hemenimo amuse huꞌa natesayafeꞌmo nahaꞌye nehisigeꞌna kahauya nehuvesinana Kalaisi aliꞌyaꞌaleꞌmo oꞌmauvesine.
Poloꞌa Goti apa vekaꞌamo hamaleꞌniya kavafeꞌmo ava gemo huꞌniya gemae
Konagaꞌnimogitapae, ma mopafi vayaꞌmogi alagepa faigoko gemo aeꞌna hakalo huꞌna hapa nepauva gemo aepa vayaꞌmo oꞌmaiꞌnae, huꞌna lapa nepauva gemo alagepa huta afiyo.
Nagaemo mago vekalegatiꞌmo mani gemo oꞌalige mago vekamoꞌa alino naya oꞌmalege huꞌniyana Yesu Kalaisiꞌa agaiꞌageꞌmo alino nave liꞌnigeꞌna ageteꞌna afiꞌnove.

Lapakaemo ago afiꞌnayana Yu nofi vayaꞌmogi nehaya kava huꞌna mono huꞌnova kavafeꞌmo nava gemo ago afiꞌnae. Nagaemo Goti siosi vayaꞌalegamo lusi kava huꞌna naini huꞌna apateteꞌna siosi vayaꞌmo aliꞌna hano huꞌna apatalesuvafeꞌmo huꞌnove.
Nagaemo Yu nofi vayaꞌmo nehaya kava huꞌna magoꞌe huꞌna huliꞌna neꞌuꞌnaeꞌmo nafaluꞌnimogimo ago aeꞌna apakaseꞌna laginago vayaꞌai gemo akame nehuꞌnaeꞌmo lusi kava huꞌna nayamukiki huꞌna maiꞌnove.

Huꞌna maiꞌnovaꞌmonanafa itaꞌnimoꞌmo alino oꞌnateꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo hogoteno Gotiꞌa hauꞌniya afinaꞌmo agaiꞌalefeꞌmo ago lekana paino nateteno fiku naha maeno namiꞌniya kavatetiꞌmo nagaefeꞌmo keya aeno ge huꞌniye.

Agaemo Mafaꞌneꞌaeꞌmo ava gemo malaga nofi vayaꞌaifeꞌmo aeꞌna hakalo huꞌna hapa paisuvafeꞌmo Gotiꞌa hauꞌniya afinaꞌmo Mafaꞌneꞌamo naipafiꞌmo alino nave liꞌnigeꞌna ageteꞌnaeꞌmo uꞌna mago vayaꞌeꞌmo ge huge afige huꞌna oꞌmaiꞌnove.
Nagaemo hogote apa vayaꞌmo uꞌna apakesuvafeꞌmo Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo oꞌuꞌnovaꞌmonanafa Alepiya kotegamo uꞌna kaꞌme koteꞌmo maigeꞌna halate aiꞌna atagi neꞌna Namasakasi taonifiꞌmo eꞌna maiꞌnove.
Loleꞌe magoꞌe kafugamo utegeꞌna Pitaꞌmo uꞌna agesuvafeꞌmo Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo uꞌna lole salemo maiꞌneꞌnaeꞌmo
mago alu apa vayaꞌamo oꞌapakeꞌnovaꞌmonanafa Yemisiꞌa Ala kava neꞌmo aganaꞌamokeꞌmo ageꞌnove.
Goti aulagaleꞌmo maiꞌneꞌnaeꞌmo aigofe gemo nosufa alagi lama gemo huꞌna avoꞌmo nekaove.
Henagaꞌamo Siliya kotegaꞌe Silisiya kotegaꞌeꞌmo uꞌna maiꞌnogeꞌapaeꞌmo
Yutiya kotega siosile vayaꞌmo Kalaisipiꞌmo maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmogimo naugosamo oꞌnageꞌnae.

Oꞌnageꞌnayaꞌmonanafa mago vayaꞌmogi, ani vekamoꞌa aini huno lateteno apakesa afiꞌa fatago hisaya faigoko gemo alino hano huno atalesiyafeꞌmo huꞌniya vekamoꞌmo hemenimo ani gemo aeno hakalo huno hapa nepaiye, huꞌa hapa paiꞌnageꞌa afiteꞌapaeꞌmo
nagaetetiꞌmo Goti agiꞌaleꞌmo aliꞌa asaga huꞌa ateꞌnae.
